final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" o JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = o.account_id AND p.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = p.client_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diff AS (SELECT account_id, region, cnt, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff FROM c), r AS (SELECT account_id, region, cnt, diff, AVG(diff) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS rd FROM diff) SELECT account_id, region, cnt AS num_orders, diff AS diff_from_overall_avg, diff - rd AS excess_over_region_avg_diff FROM r WHERE diff > rd ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg_diff DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
